name: Task_8
description:
Generate a training dataset of potential energies for perturbed Silicon structures. Start with a conventional cubic unit cell of diamond Silicon (a = 5.43 \u00c5) expanded into a 2 \u00d7 2 \u00d7 2 supercell using the MACE-MP-0 model as the calculator. Generate 100 configurations by applying atomic displacements drawn from a normal distribution with standard deviation 0.01 + 0.001 \u00d7 i \u00c5 for configuration index i \in [0, 99], and evaluate their potential energies.

Use the supplied teacher_model checkpoint and independent, unrelaxed copies of the ideal periodic 64-atom cell, and retain total energies in eV in generation order. Use a recorded random seed to generate and label the 100 structures with your own code; retain their row identities.
